en: Waiter! / Excuse me (to call staff — 你好 also works)
exEn: Excuse me, we'd like to order!

en: How many people? (what staff ask you)
exEn: — How many? — Two.
Could I see the menu, please?
I'll have a bowl of beef noodles.

en: Bring me one… (casual way to order)
exEn: One kung pao chicken, please.

ex: 第一次来，有什么推荐的吗？
exEn: It's my first time here, what do you recommend?
This dish not spicy, please.

zh: 微辣 / 中辣 / 特辣
say: wēi là / zhōng là / tè là
exEn: I'll have it mild.
I'm vegetarian, do you have vegetable dishes?
I'm allergic to peanuts.
No cilantro, please.
Let's order a plate of dumplings.
Two more bowls of rice, please.
This place's noodles are really good.

en: Hot water / tea (often served free with meals)
exEn: A glass of hot water, please.

en: Beer (冰的 = cold — ask, as it may come warm)
exEn: Two cold beers, please.
Could I have another pair of chopsticks?
This is so delicious!
— For here or to go? — To go.

en: To pack up leftovers / to go
exEn: Excuse me, could we box this up?
Let's order delivery tonight.

en: The check, please (结账 jiézhàng also works)
exEn: Excuse me, the check please!
Hi, how much is it altogether?

ex: 我没有现金，可以刷卡吗？
exEn: I don't have cash, can I pay by card?

en: Can I pay by scanning the QR code? (WeChat Pay / Alipay)
exEn: Can I pay with Alipay?
